title: ISic001789. Fragment of a monumental Latin inscription
body:
Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: autopsy Prag 2015-03-15, cassette 20, magazzino B, Museo Archeologico Regionale Paolo Orsi
1[---]Q(uinti) · f(ilio) ·

Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: autopsy Prag 2015-03-15, cassette 20, magazzino B, Museo Archeologico Regionale Paolo Orsi
1[---]Q·F·

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text based on autopsy;
  • 1: The tail under the F must be from a preceding Q

English translation

Jonathan Prag

[---] son of Quintus [---]

commentary

Whether this is the first line of the text or not is impossible to say; it presumably continued either on the line below or on an adjoining plaque. It seems most likely that this is part of a public honorific text, but it is not possible to say more, given lack of provenance and other information. The fragment is unpublished.

bibliography

Large v-cut letters with wedge serifs.Light arrow-head shaped interpuncts.

Line 1 Slightly greater than the preserved 75 Interlineation line 1 to 2
